title: Magnificent Home - 1 King / 6 Queen Beds + Balcony
description:
NEW: Visit Nashville in this modern home with 7 beds and stunning a balcony with a fireplace! You'll be just 10 minutes away from Broadway and Nashville's Downtown core, where you'll discover all the best attractions in Music City!

This brand-new home has it all and is beautifully decorated with designer finishes. You'll enjoy a huge living room and a complete kitchen. The beds are luxurious and comfy, plus the bathrooms are pristine!

I can't wait to host you in this New Construction home!

The space
This new construction home is the perfect launchpad for your Nashville adventure. All the furniture is brand-new and modern.

There are two large living rooms with Netflix Equipped Smart TVs, a beautiful kitchen with everything that you'll need for cooking, lightening fast W-Fi, 50" smart televisions, complimentary coffee, a wonderful dining area, and a large balcony with a dining table and gas fireplace. 

This is truly one of the best spots in Nashville!

Each bedroom has a luxurious bed with 600 thread count sheets and luxurious pillows. There's a King bed in the master bedroom, along with a Television, a walk-in closet, and a large washroom. 

There are two bedrooms with one Queen bed in each. The fourth bedroom has two bunkbeds with Queen sized bunks! This gives you 4 Queen sized bunks in the fourth bedroom!

There is tons of space at this property, so you'll never feel crowded at this property. There's also a garage that fits one car, and outdoor parking for an additional two vehicles.

Guest access
You'll have exclusive use of the entire home during your stay. None of the amenities will be shared with other groups.

Other things to note
Nashville has highways and trains throughout the city. You can see/hear the highway from my home, and from time to time you'll hear a train pass by nearby.

This home has a large number of stairs. It is not a good fit for people who have trouble with stairs.
